_sobre: Hands as pendulums (hand_pendulum.py; Rafael, 2026-11-15: hands and fingers as pendulums following the armature, the wrist mixed, a spring towards the captured hand, with anatomical limits; nothing non-anatomical). Angles in degrees. Where sources disagree the smaller range is used.

limites._fontes: Wrist flexion/extension: eatonhand.com/clf/clf218.htm (75/70); radial/ulnar deviation: AAOS as quoted by Queen's University (20/30). Fingers and thumb: the AAOS-based table in Hendriks et al. 2020, PRS Global Open, supplementary (MCP 80, PIP 90, DIP 65, extension 0; thumb MCP 50, IP 80). Forearm rotation 80 each way: textbook order, not checked in a source this session.

repouso._sobre: the relaxed hand the fingers return to, by eye

punho._sobre: a damped spring towards the captured hand (by eye): its frequency sets how closely it follows, gravity and the forearm's acceleration bend it away

dedos._sobre: each joint a damped pendulum towards the relaxed hand (by eye); segment masses in grams, proximal, middle, distal (by eye; only their ratio matters)
